item.title: seen here
item.content:encoded:
This page serves as a repository for active calls for papers across various special issues. The journal invites submissions that fall within the scope of each specific call and encourages authors to contact the relevant guest editors for details about individual special issues.

Authors preparing submissions should follow the journal's author guidelines. The journal also welcomes proposals for new special issues from the editorial team.

Appel publié par International Journal of Selection and Assessment. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
